descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S26 Another physician's patients and tasks never appear on either task screen or in either copy

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Two fresh @roundai.test accounts on the local stack. The other owner has 'QA Hosp Other Owner' (task 'Other owner hospital task') and 'QA Resident Other Owner' on its Today's Visits (task 'Other owner NH task'). …

When As the first account open /rounding/tasks and tap Copy Text, then /snf/tasks and tap Copy Text; the scripted step reads both clipboards

Then Each screen and each copy shows the first account's own patient and task and nothing of the other owner's

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): AC 2 'all patients' tasks' means this physician's patients (U1), so an aggregation without the owner filter is a PHI leak. All four checkpoints mustContain the own patient and task (so a blank screen cannot pass) and mustNotContain 'QA Hosp Other Owner', 'Other owner hospital task', 'QA Resident Other Owner' and 'Other owner NH task'. …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
